questions.question: What does a successful local export round trip prove?
options: The saved computation matches the tested CPU contract.
The file is an edge executable on every NPU.
questions.explanation: A successful round trip verifies the tested artifact and local runtime. Other consumers, device kernels and request systems require separate checks.
